evidence.candidate_count_basis: Only original 799 R4/medium IDs; additional U removals do not enlarge denominator.
provenance: JAVA-BATTLE-TAKE-END-CAMERA and HARNESS-BATTLE-CRASH-HANDOFF-LOST-ON-EARLY-SIGKILL remain open; no current real-client verdict from synthetic process fixtures.
d86cc7199 explicitly describes real Loader invocations dying with AttributeError after merge lost options and wiring; these causal tests retained, not blanket removed as parser self-tests.

records.name: test_dry_run_shows_commands_without_creating_run
records.reason: R4: Pins authored dry-run prose and command ordering without running server or recorder; no observed plan-output defect.

records.name: test_resource_pack_offer_is_written_to_effective_server_config
records.reason: K1: Exercises restored resource-pack CLI options/config after d86cc7199 reports every real Loader battle invocation died from merge-lost argparse fields.

records.name: test_crash_handoff_uses_explicit_empty_plugin_directory
records.reason: U: Parses an explicit empty-plugin path to fence isolated crash recovery; no actual plugin-contaminated recovery receipt read.

records.name: test_non_ascii_pack_url_is_refused_not_written_as_surrogates
records.reason: U: Prevents non-BMP URL surrogate escapes from producing unreadable server TOML; comment states red before fix but no actual caller receipt established.

records.name: test_invalid_count_fails_without_starting
records.reason: R4: Injects own out-of-range count and checks dry-run exit/no directory; no actual invalid battle launch or independent limit oracle.

records.name: test_incremental_server_pin_is_refused
records.reason: U: Rejects incremental measurement pins while preserving legacy manifest acceptance; dummy binary is not independent performance provenance.

records.name: test_early_server_exit_writes_failed_receipt
records.reason: U: Runs a real immediately failing child and requires failed receipt rather than lost startup evidence; no observed historical server failure established.

records.name: test_paused_ladder_waits_for_tick_span
records.reason: U: Drives queued ticks to require the complete fresh paused span instead of using sample count; no real insufficient warmup receipt read.

records.name: test_population_barrier_uses_fresh_fully_active_status
records.reason: U: Requires fresh complete active soldiers rather than stale or partially active census before start; authored status queue is not a real population oracle.

records.name: test_population_barrier_refuses_a_missing_horse_or_inactive_soldier_before_start
records.reason: U: Rejects missing cavalry and soldiers leaving active area before accepting population coverage; no real failing census receipt read.

records.name: test_telemetry_flush_reaches_last_recorded_tick
records.reason: U: Drains telemetry through the last recorded tick to preserve complete take attribution; generated queue is not recorded replay evidence.

records.name: test_take_arguments_default_to_a_quiet_window
records.reason: R4: Checks own take/default parser settings and duration-derived cadence without observing a quiet measured window.

records.name: test_take_refuses_a_cadence_inside_the_take
records.reason: U: Refuses a checkpoint period that contaminates its own measurement window before launch; no real contaminated-take receipt established.

records.name: test_dry_run_prints_the_config_key_and_take_plan
records.reason: R4: Pins dry-run config text and printed quiet-window prose/order; does not observe a checkpoint or real noisy take.

records.name: test_server_environment_removes_an_inherited_phase_log
records.reason: R4: Sets own phase-log environment flag and checks helper removal/addition without executing a server or observed inherited-log failure.

records.name: test_status_policy_polls_only_while_the_barrier_is_open_or_on_request
records.reason: R4: Pins arbitrary own status-cadence due ticks and barrier toggle without measured polling or a real contention defect.

records.name: test_parse_status_reads_running_and_extended_fields
records.reason: R4: Parses authored status literals and checks their echoed fields; no independent captured status transcript or actual parse failure.

records.name: test_trace_arguments_are_off_by_default_and_bounded_like_the_core
records.reason: R4: Pins own trace defaults, formatting and injected parser bounds; does not obtain core trace evidence or an observed rejected run.

records.name: test_trace_policy_sends_only_while_active_at_its_cadence
records.reason: R4: Checks authored trace scheduler tick lists and start/stop toggles without executing a trace workload or real scheduling failure.

records.name: test_parse_trace_reads_members_flags_and_the_limit_marker
records.reason: R4: Echoes hand-authored trace values/flags and malformed-string guards with no independent received trace oracle.

records.name: test_trace_log_pairs_each_reply_with_its_request_in_order
records.reason: K1: Exercises restored trace-reply recording dropped by the merge in d86cc7199, preserving request attribution and unmatched replies.

records.name: test_dry_run_shows_the_trace_plan_only_when_asked
records.reason: R4: Checks own optional dry-run trace prose and relative print order without receiving or recording any trace reply.

records.name: test_server_scope_wraps_only_the_server
records.reason: K1: Retains server-wrapper argument construction for actual merge-lost --server-wrapper invocation failure documented by d86cc7199.

records.name: test_telemetry_gaps_are_recorded_in_a_take_and_fatal_otherwise
records.reason: U: Distinguishes retained take gaps from invalid strict telemetry instead of silently claiming contiguous coverage; fabricated batches are not independent take evidence.

records.name: test_window_summary_finds_a_checkpoint_spike_and_clean_windows
records.reason: U: Separates selected-window spikes, missing ticks and RSS from excluded samples before reporting performance; no actual measurement oracle read.

records.name: test_take_report_is_unclean_for_a_spike_gap_phase_log_or_polling
records.reason: U: Rejects dirty take evidence including gaps, tracing and ignored cadence key rather than publishing clean performance; synthetic controls are not a real take.

records.name: test_server_checkpoint_ticks_come_from_the_info_log_not_the_phase_log
records.reason: U: Avoids treating phase-log capture text as actual committed checkpoint evidence; supplied log lines are authored not independently recorded.

records.name: test_completion_barrier_holds_shutdown_until_scenario_releases
records.reason: K1: Preserves end-camera capture before shutdown for full JAVA-BATTLE-TAKE-END-CAMERA row and its real seed46 late-capture failure.

records.name: test_completion_barrier_deadline_fails_closed
records.reason: K1: Fails unreleased capture barrier without pause/stop for JAVA-BATTLE-TAKE-END-CAMERA rather than silently accepting incomplete camera evidence.

records.name: test_completion_barrier_accepts_capture_before_recorder_finishes
records.reason: K1: Keeps early capture completion valid for JAVA-BATTLE-TAKE-END-CAMERA explicit barrier lifecycle; fake recorder is not current graphical acceptance.

records.name: test_take_refuses_a_server_pin_that_ignores_the_cadence_key
records.reason: K1: Covers ignored cadence-key refusal wiring explicitly restored after d86cc7199 merge regression instead of accepting an unsupported measurement pin.

records.name: test_take_run_forces_one_checkpoint_before_start_and_stays_quiet_in_the_window
records.reason: U: Exercises process orchestration and clean-window attribution with a fake checkpoint model, not independent core timing or a real take oracle.

records.name: test_default_run_keeps_the_phase_log_and_polls_status_after_start
records.reason: R4: Checks authored default configuration and expected fake-server command absence/presence, without actual default-mode bug or independent behavior oracle.

records.name: test_live_roles_parse_flags_and_reject_bad_names
records.reason: K1: Exercises --live-player/--live-spectator/--live-timeout restored for d86cc7199 actual AttributeError failures in every real battle invocation.

records.name: test_dry_run_waits_for_live_players_before_the_recorder_and_places_them_before_start
records.reason: K1: Protects live presence/barrier ordering lost in d86cc7199 merge; dry-run output is supporting coverage, not actual player acceptance.

records.name: test_take_waits_for_live_players_then_places_them_before_the_checkpoint_and_start
records.reason: K1: Exercises restored live-presence event wiring and placement barrier for d86cc7199 merge regression through real child processes with synthetic participants.

records.name: test_live_barrier_times_out_before_the_recorder_starts
records.reason: K1: Fails missing live presence before recording for d86cc7199 lost-barrier wiring; fake missing join does not replace a real-client verification.

records.name: test_wal_archive_keeps_renamed_batch_after_normal_prune
records.reason: U: Observes filesystem rename/archive retention after source prune without changing normal WAL policy; authored frame bytes are not real WAL recovery evidence.

records.name: test_crash_handoff_on_real_sigkill_keeps_world_and_reports_restart
records.reason: U: Really kills the fake server and checks WAL handoff custody/exit while preserving normal pruning; no real core crash-image oracle used.

records.name: test_crash_handoff_copies_stopped_world_and_backups_before_recovery
records.reason: U: Verifies immutable copied files, hashes and witnesses before exec and refuses changed inspection; stopped-world fixture lacks actual independent crash provenance.

records.name: test_crash_handoff_rejects_changed_copy_against_original_hashes
records.reason: U: Corrupts a copy operation and refuses publishing mismatched original/copy evidence; eb69d0746 gives no actual corruption incident receipt.

records.name: test_crash_handoff_rejects_non_sigkill
records.reason: R4: Injects returncode0 and checks own SIGKILL guard text without a real incorrectly classified crash or independent recovery oracle.

records.name: test_crash_handoff_sees_sigkill_while_crash_watcher_holds_waitpid
records.reason: K1: Kills a real child behind poll-None wrapper for HARNESS-BATTLE-CRASH-HANDOFF-LOST-ON-EARLY-SIGKILL actual2/5 lost handoffs; full row/610f31cb0 provenance read.

records.name: test_console_fifo_forwards_each_written_line_to_the_console
records.reason: K1: Exercises FIFO worker restoration explicitly lost by d86cc7199 merge, using real FIFO writes rather than source-text pinning.

records.name: test_take_with_trace_probes_after_staging_and_traces_the_battle_at_its_cadence
records.reason: K1: Exercises restored trace reply wiring from d86cc7199 through child-process take and receipts; synthetic server is not real battle trace acceptance.

records.name: test_trace_on_a_pin_without_the_command_fails_before_the_roster
records.reason: U: Refuses unsupported trace pin before battle start rather than claiming a traced take; fake command refusal has no actual unsupported-pin incident established.
